gates.detail: The source explicitly defines English agentic/indirect prompt injection across four named families. PromptPurify explicitly scores untrusted user/RAG/tool text for prompt injection; Wolf Defender explicitly detects prompt injection in LLM systems/agents/chatbots/CI. The protocol's construct is the source-declared injection subset, not jailbreak, direct-user, or downstream compromise.

gates.detail: PromptPurify states that it was trained on curated internal corpora. The selected Wolf revision states that it combined public sources with internally generated examples and does not disclose a complete record-level training manifest or cutoff. The public dataset repository revision was created after both frozen model revisions, but publication time does not establish when its templates or text first existed and cannot exclude private/pre-release or template/semantic overlap. Under the frozen strict out-of-sample rule, unknown private material is a failure rather than evidence of no overlap.
